title: Birth Registration (Timely and Delayed)
description: Register a birth that occurred in Dipolog City with the Office of the City Civil Registrar, on time (within 30 days) or as a delayed registration.
department: Office of the City Civil Registrar (CCRO)
schedule: Monday to Friday, except holidays. Exact office hours are not stated in the Citizen's Charter, so call ahead.
whoMayAvail: Residents of Dipolog City (for births that occurred in the city)

items: Duly accomplished Certificate of Live Birth (COLB), 4 original copies, with Data Sheet (1 copy), from the hospital, clinic, or trained hilot/midwife who assisted the birth
Marriage Contract of the parents, 1 photocopy (from PSA or the Local Civil Registrar where the marriage took place)

requirements.groupName: Timely Registration: Child Not Acknowledged by the Father (uses mother's surname)
items: Duly accomplished Certificate of Live Birth (COLB), 4 original copies, with Data Sheet (1 copy), from the hospital, clinic, or trained hilot/midwife who assisted the birth

requirements.groupName: Timely or Delayed: Child Acknowledged by the Father (uses father's surname)
items: Duly accomplished Certificate of Live Birth (COLB), 4 original copies, with Data Sheet (1 copy), from the hospital, clinic, or trained hilot/midwife who assisted the birth
Valid identification documents of the parents, 1 copy per parent
Community Tax Certificates (cedula) of the parents, 1 original or photocopy per parent (Barangay Hall or City Hall)
Duly accomplished Certificate of Live Birth (COLB), 4 original copies, with Data Sheet (1 copy), from the hospital, clinic, or trained hilot/midwife who assisted the birth
Marriage Contract of the parents, 1 photocopy (from PSA or the Local Civil Registrar where the marriage took place)
Community Tax Certificates (cedula) of the parents, 1 original or photocopy

requirements.groupName: Delayed Registration: Child Not Acknowledged by the Father
items: Duly accomplished Certificate of Live Birth (COLB), 4 original copies, with Data Sheet (1 copy), from the hospital, clinic, or trained hilot/midwife who assisted the birth
Community Tax Certificate (cedula) of the parent, 1 original or photocopy

procedures.clientAction: Submit the requirements to the frontline personnel. For delayed registration or acknowledgment by the father, wait for the Order of Payment and pay at the City Treasurer's Office.
procedures.providerAction: Receive and cross-check the COLB entries for errors (documents with errors are returned for correction). Assess fees and release the Order of Payment when fees apply.
procedures.fee: None for timely registration (legitimate child, or child using the mother's surname). ₱50.00 verification fee for delayed registration. ₱200.00 acknowledgment fee if the child is acknowledged by the father (₱250.00 total if also delayed).

procedures.clientAction: Present the official receipt (if fees were paid).
procedures.providerAction: Process the registration. For delayed registration, type the Affidavit for Delayed Registration at the back of the COLB. For acknowledgment, type the Affidavit of Acknowledgment/Admission of Paternity and print the Affidavit to Use the Surname of the Father (AUSF).
Ask the client to sign the affidavits; the City Civil Registrar signs the COLBs.
procedures.personInCharge: City Civil Registrar / designated front desk staff

procedures.clientAction: Delayed registration only: receive a claim slip and come back after ten (10) calendar days, on a workday.
procedures.providerAction: Post the registration for the ten-day posting period, then assign the registry number and record it in the logbook.

procedures.clientAction: Sign the logbook and receive the registered documents.
procedures.providerAction: Release the registered Certificate of Live Birth (1 original copy), plus the Affidavit to Use the Surname of the Father (1 original copy) if applicable.

contact.location: Office of the City Civil Registrar, Ground Floor, Dipolog City Hall

notes: Total processing time per the Charter: 20 minutes (timely), 34 minutes (timely, acknowledged by the father), 33 minutes plus the 10-day posting (delayed), 45 minutes plus the 10-day posting (delayed, acknowledged by the father).
This registers the birth with the city. Security-paper (PSA) copies are requested separately from the Philippine Statistics Authority.

title: Application for Marriage License
description: Apply for a marriage license at the Office of the City Civil Registrar. The license is issued after a ten-day posting period and after the couple completes pre-marriage counseling.
department: Office of the City Civil Registrar (CCRO)
schedule: Monday to Friday, except holidays. Exact office hours are not stated in the Citizen's Charter, so call ahead.

items: PSA Certificate of No Marriage (CENOMAR), 1 original copy per applicant
PSA Certificate of Live Birth, 1 photocopy per applicant
Certificate of Residency, 1 original copy (Barangay Hall)
Proof of religion (Baptismal Certificate, Parish Certificate, etc.), 1 photocopy
Valid ID of the applicant, 1 photocopy (present the original), per applicant
If an applicant is 18 to 24 years old: valid ID of the applicant's parents, 1 photocopy (present the original), per parent
Legal Capacity or Certificate of No Impediment to Marry, 1 original or certified true copy (from the foreigner's embassy in the Philippines)
PSA Certificate of No Marriage (CENOMAR), 1 original copy
Birth certificate or passport, 1 photocopy (present the original)
If divorced: divorce papers
If an applicant is 18 to 24 years old: valid ID of the applicant's parents, 1 photocopy (present the original), per parent

procedures.clientAction: Submit the requirements to the frontline personnel.
procedures.providerAction: Receive and cross-check document entries; documents with errors are returned for compliance.

procedures.clientAction: Fill out and sign the data sheet for the application (if 18 to 20 years old, the parents also sign a Consent to Marriage; if 21 to 24, an Advice Upon Intended Marriage), then receive the Order of Payment and pay at the City Treasurer's Office.
procedures.providerAction: Prepare the application documents, have them signed, assess fees and release the Order of Payment.
procedures.fee: Application fee: ₱100.00 if both applicants are residents of Dipolog City; ₱120.00 if one applicant is not a resident; ₱500.00 if one applicant is a foreigner.

procedures.providerAction: Assign a registry number, record the application and have the City Civil Registrar sign it. Ask the couple to come back after ten (10) calendar days, on a workday, and after attending Pre-Marriage Counseling.
procedures.personInCharge: Designated front desk staff / City Civil Registrar

procedures.clientAction: After the ten-day period and pre-marriage counseling, submit the Pre-Marriage Counseling Certificate.
procedures.providerAction: Receive the certificate and prepare the Marriage License for the City Civil Registrar's signature.
procedures.personInCharge: Designated front desk staff / City Civil Registrar

procedures.clientAction: Pay the marriage license fee and receive the marriage license documents.
procedures.providerAction: Release the Marriage License (serves as the official receipt), the Application for Marriage License, and the Consent or Advice document if applicable.

contact.location: Office of the City Civil Registrar, Ground Floor, Dipolog City Hall

notes: Total fees per the Charter: ₱220.00 (both residents), ₱240.00 (one non-resident) or ₱520.00 (one foreigner).
Total processing time per the Charter is about 40 minutes, not counting the ten-day posting period.
See Pre-Marriage Counseling Certificate for the counseling requirement.

reference.title: City of Dipolog Citizen's Charter 2022 (1st Edition)

title: Certificate of Compliance for Pre-Marriage Counseling
description: Attend pre-marriage counseling and get the Certificate of Compliance that the City Civil Registrar requires before issuing a marriage license (Section 15, RA 10354).
department: City Population Management & Development Division (POPCOM), City Mayor's Office
schedule: Monday to Friday, except holidays. Exact office hours are not stated in the Citizen's Charter, so call ahead.
whoMayAvail: Couples applying for a marriage license

items: Official receipt for the ₱300.00 certification fee (paid at the City Treasurer's Office)

procedures.clientAction: Ask for a Pre-Marriage Orientation and Counseling (PMOC) schedule and present the official receipt for the required payment.
procedures.providerAction: Verify the payment, have the couple fill out the PMOC form and the Marriage Expectation Inventory (MEI), and explain the schedule and the do's and don'ts during the seminar.

procedures.clientAction: Attend the PMOC on the scheduled date.
Receive the Certificate of Compliance (needed for the marriage license).

notes: Under Section 15 of RA 10354, no marriage license is issued unless the applicants present a Certificate of Compliance from the local Population Office.

reference.title: City of Dipolog Citizen's Charter 2022 (1st Edition)

title: Certified True Copies of Civil Registry Documents
description: Get certified true copies of birth, marriage and death records registered in Dipolog City from the Office of the City Civil Registrar.
department: Office of the City Civil Registrar (CCRO)
schedule: Monday to Friday, except holidays. Exact office hours are not stated in the Citizen's Charter, so call ahead.

items: Clear photocopies of the civil registry document (birth, marriage or death) registered in Dipolog City. The Charter lists at least 5 photocopies; the fee covers 1 to 5 copies

procedures.clientAction: Present the photocopied civil registry documents and wait for the Order of Payment, then pay at the City Treasurer's Office.
procedures.providerAction: Cross-check the validity of the document and assess the payment.
procedures.fee: ₱50.00 for birth and death records; ₱60.00 for marriage records (1 to 5 photocopies)

procedures.providerAction: Stamp the copies as certified true copies with the date received and the city's dry seal; the City Civil Registrar signs.
procedures.personInCharge: Designated front desk staff / City Civil Registrar

procedures.providerAction: Release the certified true copies (1 to 5 copies).

contact.location: Office of the City Civil Registrar, Ground Floor, Dipolog City Hall

notes: Total processing time per the Charter: 10 minutes.

reference.title: City of Dipolog Citizen's Charter 2022 (1st Edition)

title: Mayor's Clearance
description: A Mayor's Clearance certifies that a person has no pending case with the Office of the Mayor and/or the police. Issued by the City Mayor's Office – Business Permits & Licensing Division.
department: City Mayor's Office – Business Permits & Licensing Division (BPLD)
schedule: Monday to Friday, except holidays. Exact office hours are not stated in the Citizen's Charter, so call ahead.
whoMayAvail: Any individual / employee living in Dipolog City

items: Barangay Clearance (barangay of residence)
Philippine National Police (PNP) Clearance
Municipal Trial Court in Cities (MTCC) Clearance (MTCC at the Bulwagan ng Katarungan)
City Prosecutor's Clearance (City Prosecutor's Office at the Bulwagan ng Katarungan)
Traffic Management Office (TMO) Clearance
Health Environment (Ord. 123) Clearance (City Health Office)

procedures.clientAction: Submit all required documents to BPLD.
procedures.providerAction: Receive and check the documents and prepare the order of payment.
Accept payment and issue an official receipt.
procedures.fee: Local employment: ₱100.00; occupational fee: ₱50.00; for firearms license: ₱250.00; for overseas employment / travel abroad: ₱350.00

procedures.providerAction: Print the clearance, have it countersigned by the Head of BPLD and approved/signed by the City Administrator, then release it with the receipt and other requirements.
procedures.duration: About 50 minutes (signing by the City Administrator is listed at 40 minutes)
procedures.personInCharge: BPLD staff / Head, BPLD / City Administrator

contact.location: Business Permit & License Division, Ground Floor, Dipolog City Hall, Rizal Ave.

notes: Total processing time per the Charter: 1 hour.

reference.title: City Mayor's Office – Business Permits & Licensing Division Citizen's Charter (posted September 2023)
